ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High dominance of low-intensity dark pixels (approx. 80-85%) with localized high-intensity white pixels (approx. 15-20%) appearing as speckling and marginal highlights.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous dark-gray to black pigment base; high-contrast white speckling distributed stochastically across the medial lobes; concentrated white pigmentation blobs located at the distal tips and along the perimeter of the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression; interior angle approximately 45-55 degrees; depth extends significantly toward the anterior fluke base.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency, variable-amplitude serrations forming a jagged boundary; peaks are most prominent and irregular on the distal half of the trailing edges.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge leading to tapering distal tips; the overall fluke profile exhibits a moderate upward sweep from the notch to the apex.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular and semi-circular high-contrast white pixel clusters consistent with barnacle attachment scars, primarily localized in the central-medial regions of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous unaligned, multi-directional white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) crossing the dark pigmented areas, notably on the left lobe and lower central region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear rake marks (predominantly diagonal) and circular scars from ectoparasites or barnacles visible across the ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant high-frequency noise/grain across the entire image field, likely due to low-light capture or sensor sensitivity, impacting the definition of fine-scale surface textures.
